transcript: My friend, there is a humble weed that Big Farmer does not wish for you to know. It grows wild in the mountains, by the roads, even in your backyard. It is called moline. These calm the fire of inflammation. It has even been studied for antiviral and antibacterial powers. You may drink it as tea, take it as capsules, or as a tincture. Each way brings the same healing breath to your body.
